title: Nightly partner claims ingest pipeline
notes: Far-domain case (ticket 009 decision 6). Batch rather than request/response: there is no user session anywhere, the trust decision is about a file's provenance rather than a caller's identity, availability failures are silent staleness inside a nightly window rather than visible downtime, and the sensitive data is health-related. Carries the one element type the payments exemplar has no analogue for — a scheduler's own metadata store acting as a control plane.
